intro: Israel is a high-tech economy, sometimes called the 'Start-up Nation'.

chapters.title: Start-up Nation
text: Israel has more start-ups per person than almost anywhere. Companies there developed USB flash drives, the Waze map app and key computer chip designs. Cybersecurity, medical devices and medicines are also big.
Large gas fields found off the coast now supply much of the country's energy.

chapters.title: Costs of living and war
text: Housing and food are expensive. Wars and reserve call-ups disrupt the economy.

keyTerms.meaning: A young company trying to grow quickly.
